route_note: Take a high-speed train from Changsha South to Xiangtan North (about 30 minutes), then a bus or taxi to Shaoshan (about 1 hour); buses run regularly from the Xiangtan station area.
see: Mao Zedong's Former Residence area Jiangxi hilltop views

route_note: Take a direct high-speed train from Changsha South to Yueyang East (about 1 hour), then a taxi or metro-style local bus to Yueyang Tower in the old town.
see: Old Street (Pedestrian Street) near Yueyang Tower
